title: shapez 2 Mod Manifest
description: Schema for shapez 2 mod manifest.json files. Field names match the game's manifest model

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema reference for editors. The game ignores this field

Description.description: Description shown in the mod list. Empty by default

Author.description: Name of the author. Empty by default

Version.description: Mod version parsed by the loader as SemVer

SavedModVersionCompabilityRangeWithSelf.description: This mod's versions that are compatible with its save data. All versions by default

GameVersionSupportRange.description: Supported shapez 2 versions. All versions by default

AffectsSaveGames.description: Whether this mod affects save games. False by default

DisablesAchievements.description: Whether this mod disables achievements. False by default

Assemblies.description: DLLs to load from the mod folder. Should include at least your own mod dll

Dependencies.description: Mods that must be installed within the version range. Empty by default

Conflicts.description: Mods this mod cannot load alongside when the version range matches. Empty by default

versionedModReference.description: Reference to another mod plus the version range it applies to

ModId.description: Serialized mod ID. Steam Workshop mods usually use the steam:<workshop-id> form

Version.description: Version range this dependency or conflict applies to

ModTitle.description: Mod title shown in messages and diagnostics
